name: Flexible Dual Grid Mesh Voxelization
definition: Determines the active sparse voxels and solves the Quadratic Error Function (QEF) to determine dual vertex positions within voxels based on mesh-voxel grid intersections.
summary: Flexible Dual Grid Mesh Voxelization computes dual vertex positions by solving a Quadratic Error Function to create a sparse dual-grid representation that handles arbitrary mesh topology without requiring watertight surfaces.
